confirmed: Team and Administration rows exist with captions Starts off. and Starts off. Administrators only.; labels Team and Administration (settings-mcp.tsx, lib/mcp.ts, messages/en-US.json).
Team has openlaw_team_add and openlaw_team_remove, write kind, Business User off, remove is destructive; read-scope credentials are refused (team.ts, workspace.ts writeTool, register.ts toolRefusal).
Removing the current Business Owner is refused with a 409 (lib/contract-team.ts, lib/matter-team.ts).

Administration has openlaw_audit_log_query and openlaw_settings_get, both read, Business User off and refused for non-Administrators; settings are masked and no Tool writes settings (administration.ts, register.ts).

API key requests and OAuth consent share selectableToolsets: ceiling membership plus at least one Tool the account type may run; consent also filters by requested scopes; nothing is pre-selected (selectable-toolsets.ts, api-keys/routes.ts, oauth-grants/routes.ts facts(), api-keys.tsx starts with an empty selection).

Enabling a ceiling row adds nothing to an existing key or grant; removing one refuses its Tools on the next call (mcp/auth.ts intersects the key or grant Toolsets with the current ceiling and applies Read-only on every request; register.ts toolRefusal; DD-029 #1166).
Each policy change still saves immediately with Settings saved. and writes org_settings.updated (mcp-settings/routes.ts, settings-mcp.tsx).

Listen stream: revocation closes the stream by credential id; heartbeat rechecks credentials every 15 s; role change closes the stream; Inbox updates only for Administrators and Legal Team Members; Document Version text, My Tasks and vocabulary produce no updates; record updates respect Visibility tiers (change-feed.ts, event-hub.ts DEFAULT_EVENT_HEARTBEAT_MS).
Every call rechecks current access regardless of cached lists (mcp/auth.ts per request, register.ts toolRefusal).

Settings MCP page, Allowed Clients, API key requests card, Active keys and grants, consent page and Advanced MCP fields are unchanged since 067c1646 apart from the caption move and Team/Administration captions (git diff 067c1646..4ca41822).
Development-only Vite proxy changes d6768fb1 and 6fcceb04 do not affect any claim.
limitations: Source inspection only. V-M42-MCP needs the independent browser walkthrough; V-M40-MCP and V-M41-MCP need a re-walk because the article bytes changed.
V-M42-MCP prerequisite 'upgraded from M41 with every Toolset in the ceiling' needs a lab upgraded across migration 0172; a fresh M42 seed cannot show the upgrade clearing.

The M42 page moved the OAuth reachability caption out of the Legal Users and Business Users rows into one note below them. The guide does not quote that note, so no change was needed; see productBugs for its wording.

Which modern Client the walkthrough uses for the list_changed check is not settled by source. Claude Code documents list_changed over a held stream on its v2 runtime (code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp); a script Client on 2026-07-28 is the deterministic option.

resources/templates/list returns the five record templates and document-versions; resources/list returns inbox, tasks/mine and vocabulary; both filtered by grant (resources.ts listResources, mcp/routes.ts).
Record numbers accept the C-, M- or R- prefix or a bare positive integer; Entity, Knowledge Item and Version addresses need UUIDs (resources.ts).
Records and views are application/json; Document Version text is text/plain (resources.ts mimeType).
Inbox resource is the Legal User Inbox or a Business User's own unconverted Requests; vocabulary is a Guide Tool available to every credential (requests.ts, guide.ts).

Prompt table: triage_inbox optional string limit 1 to 100, default 25, Legal Users with Requests; summarize_record required record as address or kind and number or id (prompts.ts, results.ts pageInput).

Each prompt returns an instruction message and an embedded resource message; getting a prompt runs no model and changes nothing; triage asks for confirmation and links to the Convert dialog; summary requests no changes (prompts.ts).
One ledger row and one rate-limited call per read or get; the embedded read reserves nothing more (calls.ts recordCall, resources.ts resourceContent, prompts.ts).
Key request, approval, collection, Claude Code, Cowork and Desktop, and troubleshooting steps are unchanged in source since 067c1646 (git diff).
limitations: Source inspection only. V-M42-C58 needs a script Client on Streamable HTTP; V-M40-CLIENT needs a re-walk because the article bytes changed.
The guide gives listen-stream parameters from the SDK 2.1.0 schema. The walkthrough should record the exact notification method names its Client receives.
V-M42-C58 'update a subscribed record' needs a record change at a tier the subscriber can see; source shows record events are filtered by the subscriber's Visibility tiers.
